review:
Cash Surge has progressive prizes above each of its five reels, with the 5,000x maximum sitting above reel three. Lightning symbols on reels 1–2 or 4–5 add 0.5x the bet to the prize above that reel and can randomly trigger the Bonus Wheel Money Award, which pays one of the prizes.

A base-game multiplier starts at 1x and grows by 0.5x every time four scatters land; it carries into free spins, which are triggered by five scatters. Before the bonus, scatters reveal +1 free spin or +1x multiplier. Pragmatic Play gives the game's maximum win as 5,000x, and the RTP is 96.52%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
